name: Unimicron Technology Corporation
blurb: Unimicron Technology Corporation (TWSE: 3037) is a Taiwanese printed circuit board (PCB) and IC substrate manufacturer headquartered in Taoyuan City. The company derives roughly 60% of revenue from PCBs and 30% from IC substrates, with the latter segment increasingly focused on ABF (Ajinomoto Build-up Film) substrates for high-performance computing and AI applications. Unimicron is consistently ranked among the top five global ABF substrate suppliers alongside Ibiden, AT&S, Nan Ya PCB, and Shinko Electric.
recent: Unimicron targeted high single-digit revenue growth in 2025 on the back of surging ABF substrate demand for cloud AI, with the company's advanced packaging CoWoS (Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate) capacity additions coming online in the second half. FY2024 delivered revenue growth of 8.5% and profit growth of 10.2%. The top customer markets are China (~40%), USA (~25%), and Taiwan (~15%), giving Unimicron meaningful exposure to US tariff and supply-chain diversification trends.
